bundles.name: The Prospector's Bundle
bundles.description: A miner's first kit — copper, tin, and the will to dig deeper.
bundles.rewardDescription: Unlocks Bramblewood — the forest thickens, and with it, richer veins.

bundles.name: The First Larder
bundles.description: A cook's pantry needs a solid foundation.

bundles.name: The Woodcutter's Bundle
bundles.description: Pine boards, willow shafts — the bones of everything you'll build.

bundles.name: The Smith's Foundation
bundles.description: Bronze and iron — the first rungs of the material ladder.
bundles.rewardDescription: Unlocks the Copper Stack upgrade — ore stacks to 25.

bundles.name: The Deep Road Bundle
bundles.description: The road underground needs rope, boards, and a lantern.

bundles.name: The Courier's Trust
bundles.description: Pip is ready to run. All they ask is a token of commitment.

bundles.name: The Armourer's Bundle
bundles.description: A full set of bronze. Not the finest protection, but better than nothing.

bundles.name: The Gem Hunter's Bundle
bundles.description: Riches found in stone, polished by patience.
bundles.rewardDescription: Unlocks the Exchange — sell directly to the market.

bundles.name: The Delver's Haul
bundles.description: The deep earth gives up its secrets to those who persist.
bundles.rewardDescription: Coal stacks to 50. A permanent shortcut halves Ashen Delve travel time.

bundles.name: The Ironbound Offering
bundles.description: Iron from the deep, wrought into something that endures.
bundles.rewardDescription: Unlocks Iron Satchel upgrade blueprints at the Bench.

bundles.name: The Loomweaver's Gift
bundles.description: Ancient bark, shadow, and sinew — the weave demands unusual things.
bundles.rewardDescription: Unlocks the first Pattern slot. The Loom begins its work.

bundles.name: The Collector's Bundle
bundles.description: Something from everywhere. The Loomhall wants proof you've wandered.
bundles.rewardDescription: Collection Log display unlocked in Homestead.

weeklyContracts.name: The Copper Run
weeklyContracts.description: The Exchange needs copper this week.

weeklyContracts.name: The Fish Feast
weeklyContracts.description: Cook enough to feed the Loomhall workers.

weeklyContracts.name: The Iron Demand
weeklyContracts.description: Smiths across the region have run short.
